selected_quotes.quote: First Run: On Cloudmonster 3 Hyper They've finally done it. On has finally made a shoe that I actually want to run in. I have always been gleeful in my disdain for On, and my belief that they are just "glorified Sketchers for people who work in offices but need their coworkers and/or customers to know they are athletic outside of work."

First run: ON LightSpray Cloudmonster 3 Hyper I finally retired my Nike's Pegasus 41s after dragging them through over 2000km (~1250 miles) over the last eight months... switching to the LightSpray Cloudmonster 3 Hyper was obviously a night and day dif
Ain't nobody hyping On Cloud 5s. It's just the default lifestyle shoe of suburbia.

On LS cloudmonster 3 hyper My underfoot gets numb, like bloodflow is bring restricted when running in these pair of shoes. Read online that its true to size but if its too wide, the recommendation would be to size up? Or totally forget about this shoe. Ps: the ride is really amazing until the numbness ruins it.

What is the most overhyped shoe of all time? I'll start: On Cloud 5s. They are everywhere right now, but the pods constantly trap rocks and they feel way too stiff for actual distance running. Honorable mention goes to the Hoka Clifton 9...

200 mile check-in: On Cloudmonster 3 Hyper (do we have a new "champion shoe" of 2026?) I ran a half marathon race in the Cloudmonster 3 Hypers this morning, and while doing so crossed the 200 mile threshold with these shoes.

On Cloudboom Strike - Underrated I am on my third pair of On Cloudboom Strike... The shoe is super comfortable and has a good fit for people with regular/wide feet. I am usually using them for half marathons, 10k or 5k races. My first pair is almost at 600km...

Why does it have to be on cloud? The brand is rarely recommended here. Not because there's anything necessarily wrong with it, but they tend to be more expensive and less durable than your average asics/adidas/nike etc

The only thing I'll say is that this model is not for running. On Cloud 5/6 etc are for walking or wearing to work. On make actual road and trail running shoes such as Cloudboom, Cloudultra, etc. You need to buy shoes for the correct activity
